10.english_meaning: Made larger, longer, or expanded beyond the usual limit.

10.english_meaning: To reach, enter, or obtain information from a source.

10.english_meaning: Existing or occurring before the present time or event.

10.english_meaning: Relating to society, human relationships, and community living.

10.english_meaning: A particular way, style, or method of doing something.
